Print documentation of specified symbols

Usage: yak docs [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  starlark           Print documentation of user-defined starlark symbols
  starlark-builtins  Generate documentation for starlark builtins
  uquery             Print documentation for query/uquery
  cquery             Print documentation for cquery
  aquery             Print documentation for aquery
  markdown-help-doc  Print out the yak subcommand markdown docs
  help               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Universal Options:
      --isolation-dir <ISOLATION_DIR>
          The name of the directory that Buck2 creates within yak-out for writing outputs and daemon
          information. If one is not provided, Buck2 creates a directory with the default name.

          Instances of Buck2 share a daemon if and only if their isolation directory is identical.
          The isolation directory also influences the output paths provided by Buck2, and as a
          result using a non-default isolation dir will cause cache misses (and slower builds).

          [env: YAK_ISOLATION_DIR=]
          [default: v2]

  -v, --verbose <VERBOSITY>
          How verbose buck should be while logging.

          Values: 0 = Quiet, errors only; 1 = Show status. Default; 2 = more info about errors; 3 =
          more info about everything; 4 = more info about everything + stderr;

          It can be combined with specific log items (stderr, full_failed_command, commands,
          actions, status, stats, success) to fine-tune the verbosity of the log. Example usage
          "-v=1,stderr"

          [env: YAK_VERBOSE=]
          [default: 1]

      --oncall <ONCALL>
          The team that owns this command. Buck2 records it in the event log

      --client-metadata <CLIENT_METADATA>
          Metadata key-value pairs to record in the event log. Client metadata must be of the form
          `key=value`, where `key` is a snake_case identifier

      --setting <SECTION.KEY=VALUE>
          Override a Buck setting using `section.key=value`
